Name: TexturePackManager
Author: slpOff
Description:
[heading]Overview[/heading]
Texture Pack Manager is a standalone desktop application that combines multiple [b]Alternative Textures (AT)[/b] content packs into one AT pack, and multiple [b]Fashion Sense (FS)[/b] content packs into one FS pack.
Import folders or ZIP files, select the packs you want, and export the merged result. You can drag and drop multiple folders and ZIP files at once.
[b]This program cannot track updates or changes to the original mods.[/b] If a source pack is updated, import its new version and export again.
This is a desktop application, not a SMAPI mod. Alternative Textures and Fashion Sense are still required to use their respective merged packs in the game.
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Batch import through drag and drop.[/*]
[*]Checkboxes to include or exclude individual packs.[/*]
[*]One merged pack for each framework.[/*]
[*]Automatic output version selection based on the highest version among the included source packs.[/*]
[*]Problematic AT packs are excluded while the remaining valid packs are exported.[/*]
[*]Detailed error logs with automatic TXT saving and an option to save a separate copy.[/*]
[*]A pixel-style interface with a chest icon.[/*]
[/list]Some packs cannot be merged because their settings conflict. Please check the export summary and excluded-pack list.
[heading]Installation and Launch[/heading]
Both releases are [b]unsigned[/b]. The macOS release is also [b]not notarized[/b], so your operating system may display a security warning. Only proceed if you trust the download.
Windows
[list=1]
[*]Download and extract the Windows ZIP.[/*]
[*]Double-click [b]Texture Pack Manager.exe[/b].[/*]
[*]If the “Windows protected your PC” SmartScreen warning appears, click [b]More info[/b], then [b]Run anyway[/b], if that option is available.[/*]
[/list]The Windows release includes the .NET runtime, so a separate .NET installation is not required.
Some Windows security policies, including Smart App Control, may block unsigned applications without offering a “Run anyway” option.
macOS
[list=1]
[*]Install the [b].NET 8 or newer runtime[/b] if it is not already installed.[/*]
[*]Download and extract the macOS ZIP.[/*]
[*]Move [b]Texture Pack Merger.app[/b] to your Applications folder.[/*]
[*]Try opening the app once.[/*]
[*]If macOS blocks it because the developer cannot be verified, open [b]System Settings → Privacy & Security[/b].[/*]
[*]Find the message about the blocked app, click [b]Open Anyway[/b], and confirm.[/*]
[/list]The macOS release does not include the .NET runtime.
[heading]How to Use[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Drag your AT and FS folders or ZIP files into the window, or use [b]Import[/b].[/*]
[*]Check the packs you want to include.[/*]
[*]Click [b]Export[/b] and choose where to save the result.[/*]
[*]Review the summary, especially any excluded packs.[/*]
[*]Extract the exported ZIP and place the merged AT and/or FS folders in your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[/list]Back up your original packs before removing them from Mods. Remove only the original packs that were successfully included in the merged output. Keeping both the original and merged versions installed may cause duplicate or conflicting content.
Use the small [b]View Logs[/b] button to inspect detailed errors or save a TXT copy. Logs may contain local file paths, so review them before sharing.
[heading]Languages and Translations[/heading]
Currently supported languages:
[list]
[*]English[/*]
[*]Korean[/*]
[*]Simplified Chinese[/*]
[*]Japanese[/*]
[/list]The application initially follows your system language. You can change the language using the selector below the title, and your selection will be remembered.
[b]Community translations are welcome.[/b] You are free to translate the application and share your translation files. The JSON translation files are included in the source package under [b]Core/i18n[/b].
Please preserve translation keys and placeholders such as {0} and {1}. Original pack names and technical error details remain unchanged.
[heading]Respect Mod Authors[/heading]
This tool is intended to make personal mod management easier.
Please do not use it to damage other creators’ work, remove their credit, claim their content as your own, or redistribute merged packs against their permissions.
Merging a pack does not transfer ownership or change its original license. Please respect each mod author’s terms and obtain permission before sharing a merged collection.
[heading]AI Development Disclosure[/heading]
[b]This program was created entirely through AI-assisted development.[/b] Its implementation was generated with AI, based on my requirements and feedback.
Bugs and compatibility issues may remain. Please keep backups and report problems with a description of what happened and the relevant TXT log.
Automated merge tests and UI checks have passed, but the distributed Windows and macOS builds have not yet been verified on their respective operating systems.
